job_title: Director, Digitization & Automation, GWAM & GA Asia Operations
role_summary: Lead a regional transformation team to drive digitization, automation (AI, Power Platform), and process re-engineering. This is a high-visibility lead role responsible for scaling efficiency, business intelligence, and digital solutions in a complex, matrixed global operation.
must_have_requirements: Experience leading automation/AI at scale in complex environments
Expertise in Microsoft technology stack (Power Platform, Azure)
Demonstrable history as a change agent in process transformation
Strong financial acumen (cost management and benefit articulation)
Leadership experience managing high-performing, geographically dispersed teams
University degree or equivalent professional experience
nice_to_have_requirements: Entrepreneurial mindset with hands-on technical proficiency
Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in the financial services sector (GWAM/GA context)

scoring_criteria.name: Automation/AI Scale Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: The role requires moving beyond pilot projects to enterprise-wide automation.

scoring_criteria.name: Microsoft Stack Proficiency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct reliance on the MS Power Platform and Azure environment.

scoring_criteria.name: Change Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires influencing stakeholders and shifting organizational culture.

scoring_criteria.name: Financial/Business Acumen
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must translate technical automation into P&L impact and cost reduction.

scoring_criteria.name: Process Redesign Ownership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Automation of bad processes is ineffective; redesign is a prerequisite.

scoring_criteria.name: Matrix Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Success depends on working with geographically dispersed teams without direct reporting lines.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Need evidence of remote/matrix team building

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Communication
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must bridge the gap between technical teams and executive leadership.

scoring_criteria.name: Operational Risk Mitigation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Digitization must reduce, not increase, operational risk.

summary_focus: Transformational leader with specific focus on scaling regional automation for business/financial operations.
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim responsibility for global-scale AI software development if only focused on business-level process automation.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Highlight specific instances where you turned a 'complex, broken' status quo into a 'simplified, automated' success story.
bridge_gaps_honestly: Focus on expertise in scaling technology rather than years in a specific industry, if coming from outside insurance/finance.
